title: Nvidia to Invest in Chip Rival d-Matrix as Its Challengers Choose Partnership
text:
Nvidia plans to invest in d-Matrix, a seven-year-old developer of server chips for AI that aims to compete with Nvidia, according to three people with knowledge of the deal.
The planned investment is part of Nvidia’s effort to make its technology compatible with rival chip designers and bring them into its dominant hardware ecosystem, even as it has made recent market-share gains against nearly all of them.
